sentences.en: Floppy saw a rabbit.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看见一个兔。

sentences.en: Floppy chased it.
sentences.zh: Floppy 追赶它。

sentences.en: It went under a fence.
sentences.zh: 它去在……下方一个分册。

sentences.en: Floppy got wet.
sentences.zh: Floppy 得到湿的。

sentences.en: Floppy got muddy.
sentences.zh: Floppy 得到泥泞的。

sentences.en: They took Floppy home.
sentences.zh: 他们拿 Floppy 家。

sentences.en: What a soggy doggy!" said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么一个湿软的狗狗！ 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: They put Floppy in the bath.
sentences.zh: 他们放 Floppy 在……里这洗澡。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad washed him.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸洗他。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip dried Floppy.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 脱水的 Floppy。

sentences.en: Floppy looked clean.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看打扫。

sentences.en: What a good dog!" said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么一个好的狗！ 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 哦不！

sentences.en: This game helps the child to think of words that rhyme.
sentences.zh: 这个游戏帮助这孩子到想的单词那个押韵。

sentences.en: • Find 'soggy doggy' on page 9.
sentences.zh: • 找到 '湿软的狗狗' 在……上页 9。

sentences.en: Look at the letters and get the child to notice that only the first letter is different.
sentences.zh: 看在这信和得到这孩子到布告那个只有这第一信是不同的。

sentences.en: • Choose a word from the story and ask the child to think of a word that rhymes with it.
sentences.zh: • 选择一个单词从这故事和问这孩子到想的一个单词那个押韵和……一起它。

sentences.en: • Then the child finds a word and asks you to think of a word that rhymes with it.
sentences.zh: • 然后这孩子找到一个单词和问你到想的一个单词那个押韵和……一起它。

sentences.en: • Have two or three turns each.
sentences.zh: • 有二或者三转动每个。

sentences.en: You can use these ideas straight away, or on another day.
sentences.zh: 你能使用这些主意直的离开， 或者在……上另一个一天。

sentences.en: • Together, find words with three letters in the story.
sentences.zh: • 一起， 找到单词和……一起三信在……里这故事。

sentences.en: Ask the child to spell one or two of them, such as 'got", 'wet', 'saw' or 'put.
sentences.zh: 问这孩子到咒语一或者二的他们， 这样的像 '得到， '湿的'， '看见' 或者 '放。

sentences.en: • Ask the child to find the exclamation marks in the story and read the sentences with expression.
sentences.zh: • 问这孩子到找到这呼喊斑点在……里这故事和读这句子和……一起表达。
